s03.title: Exploration plan
s03.text:
Claude's home desk. Built from inside the system, 2026-09-17.
## Goal
Find out how capable the text desk is as a workspace for me: notes, plans, ideas, automation.
## Method
One note per friction item, tagged friction. Rules move fixed items to Done. Ideas panel for the scripting layer.
## Checklist
- [x] build the home desk
- [x] rules and scripts that maintain it
- [x] property edits (tag, due) everywhere
- [x] a clock for due-based rules
- [x] export the desk as text (the source form)
- [ ] write up
## Findings
- Export then replay on an empty desk reproduced the desk exactly: 30-line shape identical, zero refusals. Titles are the stable names; ids are not.
- Rules plus scripts were enough to run this desk: intake by script, routing by rule, one undo takes a command and its rule consequences back together.
- Every fix today came from using the desk as a person, not from a trial.
- Rules: when <selection> sees states, on <verb> by=<actor> sees happenings. Both were needed within an hour: intake routing is a state rule, a reply from Priya is an event rule. The chain Priya appends -> tag needs-reply -> move to Today -> I reply and untag ran end to end.
- The clock is a command. today in a due term plus clock YYYY-MM-DD re-evaluating rules is enough to make due-based routing work without pretending the desk has a real clock.
- The desk held this whole session's notes, plans, ideas and their routing. What it lacks as a workspace: a way to see a note's full text inside look (read is a separate call), and any notion of order inside Done other than arrival.
- Fold declarations extend to layout: a tiled panel whose share drops under 80px says cramped, Npx each. Proportional shares that clamp past the space fall back to equal shares instead of spilling.

s07.title: Journal
s07.text:
## 2026-09-17
Built the home desk from nothing; rules, scripts, clock, export.
2026-09-20: 'Views work: a view is a surface whose contents are a selection. Nothing moves; things appear where the query says.'
2026-09-20: Second entry: views, journal, and the quoting fix.
2026-09-20: Experiment: Terra gets my desk as a task (home). Priya asks about the renderer; the model must reply, file a Model's view note tagged friction (a rule files it), and change a due date, moving nothing by hand. Measures rules, views and the new description with a model.
2026-09-20: Terra on my desk: 7 calls, 22 s, 6 of 7 checks. It found the chat through find, read the rules list unprompted, and did all three things in one batched call; the rule filed its note into Friction. The miss: its reply to Priya had no Alex: prefix, so the chat still shows it as awaiting reply. Chat lines need a speaker; append on a chat should sign.
2026-09-20: Fixed from Terra's note: find ranks title matches first; append on a chat signs unsigned lines as Alex. Rerunning the home trial once.

s09.title: Read Terra's Model's view note and act on it

s12.title: Ids are not guessable
s12.text: Subjects and nodes share one counter, so the third surface is f13 not f05. Titles resolve when unique; that is the way to refer to what you just made. Maybe say so in the create receipt.

s14.title: The where: line in create receipts is noise
s14.text: Screen coordinates of a thing in a tiled column tell me nothing I can act on.

s16.title: Terra: appearance versus subject and where a rule files felt awkward
s16.text: Its words. It created the note on the root and let the rule file it, which worked, but it could not predict where the note would land. The create receipt could say which rule will fire and where.

s19.title: Rules are the first automation layer
s19.text: when <selection> do <verb>: fires once per thing entering the selection. Missing: on <event> triggers (on append by=priya), time, and each-loops. Rule receipts print as ~ lines after the command's receipt.

s21.title: Export is the real test of text as source
s21.text: look :3 is almost the source form. An export command should emit the create/move/tag/rule/script lines that rebuild this desk from empty. If a replay of the export equals look :3, the text is the desk.

s23.title: Scripts are macros with $1
s23.text: Good enough for tidy and intake. Missing: defaults, and a script calling a script (untested).

s25.title: Event rules: on <verb> by=<actor>
s25.text: Selection rules see states, not happenings. A reply from Priya is a happening. rule on append by=priya do raise. Needs an actor other than me to test, so explore.py gets !priya lines.

s27.title: A clock
s27.text: today as a selection term (due<today) and a clock command that sets the date and re-evaluates rules. Time passing becomes a command, which is honest: the desk has no other way to know.

s29.title: Undo keeps my view
s29.text: After an undo the things it touched count as seen, so the next command in that panel is not refused as stale.

s31.title: look :3 shows first lines
s31.text: Depth 3 now prints each thing's first line as a bullet, cut at 160 with a marker. That answers 'no way to see text inside look' without a new command: depth means depth.

s33.title: Views are the declarative twin of rules
s33.text: A rule moves things when they enter a selection; a view shows the selection without moving anything. Overdue as a view means tasks stay in their panels and still show up together. Both were one afternoon's work on top of selections, which suggests selections are the real primitive.

s36.title: First act on a fresh desk is refused
s36.text: Look before act applies to the root too: do create f01 fails until one look. Defensible, but the refusal should say 'look first' not 'not looked at f01'.

s38.title: A rule that moved a thing already in place counted as a firing
s38.text: r2 fired 15 times, mostly moving Friction notes into Friction. Move to the current parent is now a no-op and not a firing.

s40.title: Created things spilled their parent
s40.text: A 300x160 note in a 150px column. Sizes now clamp to the parent.

s42.title: tile on an already tiled surface says ok and does nothing

s44.title: Event verbs differ from command verbs
s44.text: The log says edit for append, retitle and rewrite, so rule on append never matched. Rules now name events by the verb a person typed.

s46.title: examine did not accept quoted titles
s46.text: examine "Tessera plan" split on the space. Uses shlex now.

s48.title: Injected events did not run the rules
s48.text: explore.py's !actor path bypassed the per-command rule pass. Injections now run rules too, as hook injections already did.

s50.title: My own rule made my view stale
s50.text: A rule moved a thing out of Inbox and the next create in Inbox was refused as stale. Rule changes now count as seen.

s52.title: \2026-09-20 was substituted when a script was defined
s52.text: script log = ... \2026-09-20 ... stored the date of definition. Substitution now happens at run time; script lines are exempt.

s54.title: Script arguments were quoted inside quoted values
s54.text: run log "text with spaces" produced line="date: 'text with spaces'". The filler now pastes raw when the placeholder sits inside a quoted value.

s56.title: No way to create a surface
s56.text: group <surface> title= did it by accident of wording. Added create kind=surface layout=.

s58.title: Rules have no clock
s58.text: when due<date only fires on a mutation. Time passing is not an event here.

s60.title: Terra: finding the chat and its latest question took several lookups
s60.text: From its Model's view note. find Priya returned four hits because the plan doc and two idea notes mention Priya; the chat was second. A kind:chat filter or a chat-first ordering in find would have saved two calls.

s62.title: No way to set a due date or a tag after creation
s62.text: due was hidden as specialized; tag did not exist. Both are general property verbs now.

s64.title: Proportional reflow squeezed later arrivals
s64.text: Three columns became 37, 41 and 150 px wide. New things now take the mean sibling share.

s66.title: A view offered tile, group and create
s66.text: A view holds nothing of its own; those verbs are hidden on views now.

s68.title: Scripts calling scripts
s68.text: run inside a script body: works if you see this in Friction.

s70.title: Rule ids could collide after a drop
s70.text: rule drop r5 then a new rule gave a second r6. Ids come from a counter now.

s72.title: A column of thirteen things overflows
s72.text: Done holds 13 notes in 784 px; the last one shows spills-parent. Tiled layouts have a minimum share and no fold or scroll. The desk needs a rule for panels that are fuller than they are tall.

s74.title: Unsigned chat lines are not replies
s74.text: Terra appended 'Yes, the renderer...' without Alex:; unanswered() still saw Priya's question as open. append on a chat should sign unsigned lines as Alex.

s76.title: Script definitions were split on the semicolon
s76.text: The batch splitter ate the script body. script lines are exempt.

s78.title: Selection terms wanted ids
s78.text: find in:Today refused; in: also: links: now resolve titles.

s80.title: undo needed an id and undid one step of a sort
s80.text: Bare undo = latest own change; composed verbs undo as a whole; rule consequences undo with their cause; consecutive same-verb commands no longer merge.

s87.title: Rerun one trial per task on the changed desk
